ruleset: testdata/ruleset only (isolated <ruleset>, as for the R1 oracle runs)

method.input: senders in the container write the corpus in a loop to analysisd local datagram socket /var/ossec/queue/sockets/queue, message 1:source-N:<line> (Wazuh standard message format)
method.counters: /var/ossec/var/run/wazuh-analysisd.state, written every second (analysisd.state_interval=1), sampled every 0.5 s
method.rate_window: from 2 s after the senders start to 1 s before they stop
method.output: alerts written to alerts.log and alerts.json as configured in the image (log_alert_level 3)
method.latency: not measured: analysisd gives no per-event receipt-to-alert time

note: Machine not quiet: another agent building and testing in ../flowlanes, a flow collector on UDP 2055, Evan's live single-node Wazuh stack running beside the oracle in the same Docker Desktop VM (receiving UniFi syslog). Docker Desktop runs containers in a Linux VM (WSL 2) on the same 8 cores / 16 threads as Windows, so analysisd ran on Linux in a VM while rulelanes-bench ran natively on Windows.
